mark_price.description: D-85: current mark used for unrealised_usd. Absent/null means portfolio_metrics.py falls back to entry cost basis and flags the position as unmarked, never fabricates a price.

aqe_snapshot.description: D-85: AQE's market-data view of this held ticker (sector, beta, ann_vol_pct, sc_momentum, structure, elder, elder_5d, mp_accel_state, rs_leadership, flow, choch_state — see tools/held_book_refresh.py AQE_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS). Null until the loop has refreshed this position at least once; portfolio_metrics.py excludes null-snapshot positions rather than guessing.

aqe_snapshot_as_of.description: D-85: the date aqe_snapshot was actually refreshed (an AQE export date) — carried forward honestly by held_book_refresh.py carry-forward, so this is very often NOT today's date. Never silently reset.

metrics.description: D-85: populated by tools/portfolio_metrics.py — gross_exposure_usd, leverage, net_beta_dollar, nav_beta, sector_concentration_pct, stop_audit, var, computed_from_aqe_dated, mixed_vintage, excluded_no_aqe_data. Lives HERE (not a separate file) so the journal is one proper portfolio snapshot, not just a list of positions (PM ruling, D-85).
